info.title: relink
info.description: URL shortener. Redirects are served at /{code}; links are managed under /v1 with an API key (Authorization: Bearer rlk_...) or, for people, a session from OpenID Connect sign-in. Errors are {"error":{"code","message","request_id"}}.

get.description: The Host header picks the domain: a custom domain a workspace has verified serves its own codes, and any other host the default domain's. A custom domain's settings also apply: / redirects to its root_url, /{prefix}/{code} serves a code behind one of its prefixes, codes ignore case when case_insensitive is set, and its not_found_page and gone_page replace the plain-text 404 and 410 (as text/html, under a Content-Security-Policy that allows no scripts). On the default domain / and two-segment paths are unknown paths. A custom domain whose settings name apps also serves their association files, as application/json: /.well-known/apple-app-site-association (and /apple-app-site-association) for iOS universal links, /.well-known/assetlinks.json for Android app links; without apps for that platform they are its 404. A link's app targets send iPhones and iPads to its App Store page and Android browsers to an intent: URL that opens the app or its store fallback, after targeting rules and before the destinations; crawlers and other systems follow the destinations. A protected link (its protection is set) answers 200 with its password or consent page until the visitor holds the grant cookie its form sets; disabled, expired and geo-blocked links answer as they would without it. /{code}+ (and /{prefix}/{code}+ on a custom domain) is the link's preview page: 200 text/html naming where this visit would go, or only that the link is protected, without a click. Both pages run no script and are sent with Cache-Control: no-store.

200.description: A protected link's password or consent page, or a preview page.

451.description: Not available in the visitor's country and no fallback URL is set.

503.description: The link is not cached and the database is unavailable, or the host may be a custom domain and the verified domains have not been loaded yet.

post.summary: Submit a protected link's password or consent
post.description: The form a protected link's page posts to its own path. password is checked against the link's argon2id hash, and every check takes one of the link's attempts for the hour (max_attempts, 10 by default), counted across instances; a right password gives its attempt back, so only wrong ones use the limit. consent must be yes when the link has consent text. Accepted, it answers 303 back to the same path and query with a grant cookie (rl.{code}, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax), valid 12 hours with a password and 30 days for consent alone, and revoked when the link's password or consent text changes. A link without protection answers 303 back at once. Disabled, expired and geo-blocked links answer as a GET would.

303.description: Accepted: back to the link, which now redirects.

400.description: The consent field is missing; the page again.

401.description: Wrong or missing password; the page again.

413.description: The form is larger than 4 KiB.

429.description: The link's attempts for the hour are used up; the password was not checked.

451.description: Not available in the visitor's country and no fallback URL is set.

503.description: The attempt could not be recorded, or the link could not be loaded.

get.description: Ready while not shutting down, even when the database is down (cached redirects are still served). The body reports the database state.

get.summary: The OpenAPI description of this API

get.description: Answered on every host while relink is ordering a certificate for that host from its ACME certificate authority, which fetches it over plain HTTP on port 80.

200.description: The key authorization for the token.

404.description: No pending challenge with this token for this host.

503.description: The database could not be asked about a token this instance has not loaded yet.

post.description: Refused with quota_exceeded (403) when the workspace holds as many links as its plan allows or has used its plan's clicks for the current UTC month; see GET /v1/usage. With domain, the code is on that verified custom domain and only needs to be unique there.

get.summary: List the workspace's links, newest first

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page.

get.summary: Get a link in the workspace

patch.description: Only the fields present change. null clears expires_at, max_clicks, geo and fallback_url. Changing destinations resets their health and invalidates A/B assignments.

delete.summary: Delete a link and its statistics

get.description: Clicks over any period of whole UTC hours, as a time series, grouped by up to three dimensions (top N by clicks) and filtered on any of them, optionally compared with an earlier period. Clicks of automated clients (crawlers, link-preview fetchers, monitors and HTTP tools, by a versioned list of User-Agent tokens; device class bot) are left out unless include_bots=true, and are never counted as visitors. Whole days at a granularity of a day or longer are answered from the daily rollups, kept as long as their link; anything else from the hourly rollups, kept for RELINK_CLICK_HOURLY_RETENTION_DAYS. Unique visitors are estimated by merging HyperLogLog++ sketches (relative standard error 0.81%) and are reported only when the query groups and filters by link alone; a visitor's hash changes every UTC day, so over several days visitors are counted once per day. A query that would read more than RELINK_ANALYTICS_MAX_ROWS rollup rows and sketches is refused with 422 query_too_expensive.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start, included: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, its first moment UTC) or an RFC 3339 time on a whole hour. Default: to minus 24 hours (hour), 12 weeks (week), 365 days (month) or 30 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End: a date, included, or an RFC 3339 time on a whole hour, excluded. Default: the end of the current hour (hour) or day. The period is at most 366 days.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Weeks start on Monday. A series has at most 1000 points.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: Comma-separated, at most three of link, country, device and referrer.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: Comma-separated links, each code (default domain) or hostname/code; at most 50. A link the workspace does not have is 404.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (XX for unknown); at most 50.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Comma-separated: desktop, mobile, tablet, bot, other.

parameters.name: referrer
parameters.description: Comma-separated referrer hosts, or (direct); at most 50.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Groups returned.

parameters.name: compare
parameters.description: Also count the period of the same length just before, or the same period a year earlier.

parameters.name: include_bots
parameters.description: Count clicks of device class bot. Filtering by device=bot needs it.

get.description: The workspace's plan, how many links and custom domains it holds and how many clicks it has had in the current UTC month, each with the plan's limit (null for none). Clicks are counted when the click pipeline writes them, so they trail redirects by up to the flush interval. Over a limit, creating links is refused with quota_exceeded; redirects are never refused.

post.description: Adds an unverified domain and returns the TXT record that proves it. Needs the admin or owner role. Refused with quota_exceeded (403) when the workspace holds as many domains as its plan allows (and never more than 1000), already_exists (409) when it already has this hostname.

patch.description: Needs the admin or owner role. Absent fields keep their value; null (an empty list for prefixes, false for case_insensitive) returns one to the default. Turning case_insensitive on while a code on the domain has uppercase letters is refused with failed_precondition (409). Changes reach every instance and the edge like any domain change.

200.description: The domain with its new settings.

delete.description: Needs the admin or owner role. A domain that still has links is refused with failed_precondition (409).

post.summary: Check a custom domain's TXT record now
post.description: Looks up the TXT record at verification.name through the server's DNS resolvers. When it holds verification.value the domain is verified and serves links from then on; otherwise check_error says what was found. Needs the admin or owner role and no body. A hostname another workspace verified first is already_exists (409).

Registers an endpoint for the named events (link.created, link.updated, link.expired, health.changed). Needs the admin or owner role. The url must be https on a public host. The answer carries the signing secret, which is not shown again. Each delivery is a POST of the event as JSON with Relink-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 under the secret of "<t>.<body>">, Relink-Event, Relink-Event-Id (the same on every retry, for dropping duplicates) and Relink-Delivery. Any 2xx answer is success; anything else is retried with exponential backoff. A workspace holds at most 50 endpoints (failed_precondition, 409).

get.description: Every endpoint of the workspace, oldest first, without secrets. Needs the admin or owner role.
Needs the admin or owner role. The secret is not shown.

patch.description: Needs the admin or owner role. Absent fields keep their value. Disabling an endpoint fails its pending deliveries, which can be retried once it is enabled again. rotate_secret replaces the secret at once and the answer shows the new one, once.

delete.description: Needs the admin or owner role. Its delivery log goes with it.

get.description: Deliveries newest first, kept for RELINK_WEBHOOK_RETENTION_DAYS after they finish. Needs the admin or owner role.

get.summary: One delivery with its payload and every try
get.description: Needs the admin or owner role.

post.description: Makes a failed or pending delivery due now; a failed one gets one more try. Needs the admin or owner role and no body. A delivered one, or one of a disabled endpoint, is failed_precondition (409).

get.summary: List the workspace's jobs, newest first

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page.

post.summary: Import links from a CSV or NDJSON file
post.description: The body is the file, up to RELINK_JOB_MAX_UPLOAD_MB (256 MB by default; payload_too_large, 413), read as it arrives. A CSV file starts with a header naming its columns: url, and any of code, domain, redirect_type, expires_at (RFC 3339), max_clicks, enabled, health_check (true or false), fallback_url and conversion_window_days; short_url, version, created_at and updated_at, which an export writes, are skipped. Fields may be quoted (RFC 4180); an empty field is left out. Each NDJSON line is a CreateLink body. Blank lines are skipped and no record may be longer than 64 KiB. A malformed header, a record too long or an open quote refuses the whole upload (400) and stores nothing. Each record is then checked when the job reaches it, by the rules of POST /v1/links; one that fails is listed in the job's errors by number (1 is the first record after the header) and the rest still go in. A workspace has at most 10 jobs queued or running (failed_precondition, 409).

post.summary: Export the workspace's links as CSV or NDJSON
post.description: Every link of the workspace that exists when the job is made, or every one on domain, oldest first. CSV has the columns code, domain, short_url, url, redirect_type, expires_at, max_clicks, enabled, health_check, fallback_url, conversion_window_days, version, created_at and updated_at, with a link's first destination as url, and imports again as it is; each NDJSON line is the link as GET /v1/links/{code} shows it. GET /v1/jobs/{id}/output has the file once the job has succeeded, for RELINK_JOB_RETENTION_DAYS.

Applies patch, a PATCH /v1/links/{code} body, to every link the filter picks, each with its own version, audit entry and link.updated event. The patch is checked when the job is made (400) and again at each step, so a time that has passed since fails the job. Codes the workspace does not have are listed in the job's errors at once, numbered by their place in filter.codes. Links created after the job are not changed.

get.description: Its state, rows done out of the total, and the first 100 rows that failed with the reason each would have got from the API.

post.description: Stops a queued or running job before its next step; what it has done stays done. A finished job is failed_precondition (409). No body.

get.description: The file of an export that has succeeded, streamed. Any other job is failed_precondition (409).

get.summary: Start signing in with the OpenID Connect provider
get.description: Only when RELINK_OIDC_ISSUER is set; 404 otherwise. Stores a pending sign-in, sets the relink_login cookie (10 minutes) and redirects to the provider with an authorization code request using PKCE (S256).

parameters.name: return_to
parameters.description: A path on this server to return to after signing in. Default /v1/auth/session.

get.description: The provider's redirect back. Requires the relink_login cookie to match state, takes the pending sign-in (each completes at most once), exchanges the code and checks the ID token (RS256 or ES256 signature by a provider key, issuer, audience, authorized party, expiry, issue time, nonce). The first sign-in of a person creates them with a member name of their own and a personal workspace they own. Sets the relink_session cookie and redirects to return_to.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the provider when the person declined or the request failed.

get.description: The signed-in person, the session's CSRF token and the workspaces they belong to with their role in each. Not cacheable.

post.description: Ends the session and deletes the cookie. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

Signed-in admins and owners only; API keys are refused with permission_denied. Admins invite editors and viewers, owners any role. Invite by email (accepted by whoever signs in with that address, verified by the provider) or by member name (someone who has signed in before). The answer carries the one-time link (url) and its token, shown only now. At most 100 invitations may be pending at once (quota_exceeded). Audited as invitation.create. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

get.description: Signed-in admins and owners only. Every pending invitation, then the others, newest first, at most 200. Tokens are never shown again.

delete.description: Signed-in admins (for editor and viewer invitations) and owners. Only a pending invitation can be revoked; one already accepted, revoked or expired is already_exists (409). Audited as invitation.revoke. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

get.summary: Look at an invitation before accepting it
get.description: The invitation link. Requires a signed-in person (any). Answers with the workspace and role on offer while the invitation is pending, and not_found saying why otherwise (unknown, expired, accepted or revoked). Changes nothing. Not cacheable.

post.description: Joins the workspace with the invited role. Only the person invited may accept: a verified email address equal to the invited one, or the invited member name; anyone else gets permission_denied. Each invitation is accepted at most once, before it expires and unless revoked (not_found otherwise); someone already a member gets already_exists and the invitation stays usable. Audited as invitation.accept. Requires X-CSRF-Token.

post.summary: Clicks served by the edge worker
post.description: Only present when RELINK_EDGE_TOKEN is set; 404 otherwise. Clicks are validated as strictly as on the origin and queued with them.

get.description: Totals per UTC day and breakdowns by country, device class and referrer host (top 50 each). Unique visitors are per day only: visitor hashes are keyed with a salt that changes daily, so visitors cannot be linked across days.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Default: 29 days before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Default: today (UTC). The range is at most 366 days.

get.summary: Stream a link's clicks as they happen
get.description: A server-sent events stream. It starts with an open event; then each click on the link is a click event whose data is {code, at, country, device, referrer, bot}, sent within a second of the redirect on any instance. A stream that falls more than RELINK_LIVE_BUFFER clicks behind gets a lag event with data {missed} (counted across the workspace, so an upper bound for this link) and carries on. Idle streams get a comment every RELINK_LIVE_KEEPALIVE_MS, and a stream ends after RELINK_LIVE_MAX_AGE_S or at shutdown; EventSource reconnects by itself. At RELINK_LIVE_MAX_PER_WORKSPACE streams for the workspace, or RELINK_LIVE_MAX_STREAMS on the server, 429 resource_exhausted.

parameters.name: include_bots
parameters.description: Also stream clicks from crawlers and link-preview fetchers.

get.description: The link's conversions that happened in the range, by UTC day of occurred_at, in total and per destination: what chose the URL (destination, rule, app or fallback), the A/B variant, the URL, counts per event, distinct converted clicks and value totals per currency. The link's current destinations come first, in order, even without conversions; then the URLs it no longer has, most conversions first.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Default: 29 days before to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Default: today (UTC). The range is at most 366 days.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Only this event.

post.description: Server to server: the destination posts the rl_cid query parameter a click brought, with what happened. The click id is signed by this deployment and names its link, its time and what chose the URL, so the conversion is attributed to the click, its destination and its A/B variant. A conversion is counted once per event: by external_id when given, otherwise per click; posting it again answers 200 with the stored one and duplicate true. A click id that is not valid is 400; one of another workspace's link 404; a link that does not track conversions, or a conversion after its attribution window (conversion_window_days after the click), 409 failed_precondition.

get.summary: List a link's versions, newest first
get.description: Every change to what a link does is a new version holding all of its settings; a change that sets what was already set is not. The newest 100 versions are kept.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page.

post.summary: Restore an earlier version of a link
post.description: Gives the link the settings of one of its versions again. The rollback is itself a new version, with source rollback and restored_from set, so history only grows. Restoring the settings the link already has changes nothing. A version the link does not have (any more) is not_found.

200.description: The link with the restored settings.

get.summary: List a link's scheduled changes, newest first

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page.

post.summary: Schedule a change to a link
post.description: At run_at the server applies the change once, as a new version with source schedule, within RELINK_SCHEDULE_POLL_MS (default one second). A link can have at most 20 pending schedules; beyond that the request is refused with failed_precondition (409).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The schedule's ID.

delete.description: A schedule that was already applied, failed or cancelled is refused with failed_precondition (409).

edgeToken.description: The shared secret in RELINK_EDGE_TOKEN, held by the edge worker.

session.name: relink_session
session.description: Set by signing in (GET /v1/auth/login). Acts with the rights of the person's role in the workspace named by Relink-Workspace, or in their personal workspace. Every request other than GET, HEAD and OPTIONS must also send the session's CSRF token (from GET /v1/auth/session) in X-CSRF-Token, or it is refused with permission_denied. When Authorization is present, the API key is used and the cookie ignored.

apiKey.description: rlk_ followed by 64 hex characters, created with `relink create-key OWNER`. A key carries scopes (links:read, links:write, stats:read, conversions:write); each operation lists the one it needs. A key can use a scope only if its owner's role in the workspace grants it: viewers get links:read and stats:read, editors, admins and owners all four. A missing scope or right is 403 permission_denied; an expired key is 401.

Domain.name: domain
Domain.description: The custom domain the code is on; absent for the default domain. A hostname the workspace does not have finds no link.

DeliveryId.name: delivery
DeliveryId.description: The delivery's ID, as the delivery log and the Relink-Delivery header show it.

Workspace.name: Relink-Workspace
Workspace.description: The workspace the request is meant for. An API key acts only in its own workspace, which is the default; naming another is refused with permission_denied. A session acts in the named workspace if the person is a member, else in their personal workspace.

InviteToken.name: token
InviteToken.description: The token from the invitation link. It is a credential: relink never logs it.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: The session's CSRF token; required on every state-changing request authenticated by the session cookie.

Redirect.description: Redirect to the destination (or the fallback URL). A/B links may set an assignment cookie.

Error.description: An error. Codes: invalid_argument 400, unauthenticated 401, permission_denied 403, quota_exceeded 403 (the workspace is at a plan limit, or has the most pending invitations it may have), not_found 404, method_not_allowed 405, already_exists 409, payload_too_large 413, unsupported_media_type 415, resource_exhausted 429 (with Retry-After), internal 500, unavailable 503 (with Retry-After).

member.description: The person's name in workspace memberships.

url.description: http or https; no credentials; public hosts only unless configured otherwise.

AppTargets.description: Where phones go instead of the destinations. A refused part is invalid_argument with its path, such as app.android.package.

store_url.description: The App Store page, for iPhones and iPads the app did not open the link on (an installed app opens it first through the domain's universal links). Follows the rules destinations do.

url.description: The deep link the app opens at: scheme://..., printable ASCII without #, with a lowercase scheme other than http, intent, javascript, data, file, vbscript, about, blob or filesystem.

store_url.description: Where the browser goes without the app; the package's Play Store page when absent. Follows the rules destinations do.

Apps.description: The apps a domain belongs to; every path on it is associated. A refused part is invalid_argument with its path, such as apps.ios[0].team_id.

sha256_cert_fingerprints.description: SHA-256 signing-certificate fingerprints, 64 hex digits with or without colons; stored as uppercase pairs joined by colons.

Rule.description: Sends the visitor to url when the condition under if holds. Rules are tried in order and the first that holds wins; when none does, the link's own destinations apply.

url.description: Checked and normalised like a destination.

Condition.description: One key: all, any or not to combine conditions (nested at most 8 deep), or a leaf. A link's rules hold at most 64 leaves in all; a leaf's list holds 1 to 300 values. An unknown visitor attribute never matches a list.

language.description: Language tags such as en or pt-BR; en also matches en-GB. Compared with the visitor's most preferred Accept-Language tag.

referrer.description: Hostnames; a subdomain of a listed host also matches.

query.description: Holds when the query parameter is present or, with values, has one of them (compared after percent-decoding).

TimeWindow.description: Every part given must hold. days and hours are read at utc_offset_minutes.

before.description: Holds until just before this instant; later than after.

hours.description: [start, end): start included, end not. An end before the start wraps midnight; 24:00 may end a window.

CreateLink.description: Give exactly one of url and destinations.

alias.description: Custom code. Reserved words are refused.

fallback_url.description: Used for geo-blocked visitors and when every destination is unhealthy.

domain.description: A custom domain the workspace has verified; absent or null for the default domain.

rules.description: Targeting rules, tried in order. A refused list is invalid_argument with the JSON path of the part at fault, such as rules[1].if.all[0].country[2].

conversion_window_days.description: Track conversions: every click carries a signed click id in the rl_cid query parameter, and conversions posted with it are attributed to the click for this many days.

ProtectionInput.description: A password or consent page in front of the redirect. On PATCH an absent field is kept and null removes it. A refused field is invalid_argument naming it, such as protection.password.

password.description: 4 to 256 bytes without control characters. Stored only as an argon2id hash and never returned. Protected links are served by the origin, never the edge.

max_attempts.description: Wrong passwords accepted per hour, across instances; 10 when a password is set without it. Needs a password; ignored on PATCH while the link has none.

consent.description: Text the visitor agrees to before continuing, shown as plain text with its line breaks. Trimmed; control characters other than newlines are refused.

Protection.description: A link's password and consent page as returned: never the password.

password.description: Present when the link asks for a password.

max_attempts.description: With a password: wrong passwords accepted per hour.

rules.description: Replaces the whole list; null or [] removes the rules.

app.description: Replaces the app targets; null or {} removes them.

protection.description: Changes the password and consent page field by field; null removes both. Not part of the link's versions, so a rollback leaves it as it is.

conversion_window_days.description: A new attribution window; null stops tracking conversions.

domain.description: The custom domain the link is on; null for the default domain.

healthy.description: null when health checks are off.

rules.description: Targeting rules in order, with destinations normalised; [] for none.

app.description: App targets, with store URLs normalised; null for none.

protection.description: The password (only that there is one) and consent page; null for none.

conversion_window_days.description: Days a conversion is attributed to a click; null when the link does not track conversions.

version.description: The link's current version; see GET /v1/links/{code}/versions.

day.description: UTC days since the Unix epoch; today, yesterday or tomorrow.

limit.description: null: the plan sets no limit.

InvitationRequest.description: Exactly one of email and member.

email.description: Set when invited by email address (lower case).

member.description: Set when invited by member name.

email.description: Set when invited by email address (lower case).

member.description: Set when invited by member name.

token.description: Shown only in this answer; only its SHA-256 is stored.

url.description: The one-time link to send to the person invited.

period_start.description: First day of the current UTC month.

period_end.description: First day of the next month, when the click meter starts again.

hostname.description: A public hostname such as go.example.com, without scheme, port or path. Stored lowercase with IDNA applied.

verification.description: The DNS record to publish to verify the domain.

check_error.description: Why the last attempt did not verify the domain.

certificate.description: Null until the domain is verified; then its TLS certificate from the ACME certificate authority. Stays pending while RELINK_ACME_DIRECTORY is not set.

status.description: issued once there is a certificate (a failed renewal then shows in error); failed when the last attempt for a first certificate failed.

renew_at.description: Two thirds of the way through its lifetime, when it is renewed.

checked_at.description: The last attempt to issue or renew.

next_attempt_at.description: After a failure, when the next attempt is due.

settings.description: What the domain does besides serving its links; every field is shown, null or empty when unset.

apps.description: As Apps, with both lists always present.

root_url.description: Where / redirects (302). Follows the rules destinations do.

not_found_page.description: HTML for 404: unknown codes, disabled links and paths that are not a code here. {{code}} and {{host}} are replaced, HTML-escaped.

gone_page.description: HTML for 410: expired links and links at their click limit. Same placeholders.

prefixes.description: Path segments accepted in front of a code, so /campaign/abc is the link abc. Stored lowercase; reserved words are refused.

case_insensitive.description: Whether /ABC and /abc are the same link. Links created on the domain then get lowercase codes.

apps.description: Replaces the apps the domain belongs to; null removes them.

url.description: https, a public host, no credentials.

secret.description: The signing secret, only when the endpoint was just registered or its secret rotated. The whole string is the HMAC key.

next_attempt_at.description: When a pending delivery is next tried.

last_status.description: The last answer's status; null when there was none.

payload.description: The event exactly as posted: id, type, created_at, workspace_id and data. data has the link (as GET /v1/links/{code} shows it); link.updated adds changed (field names) and previous (their old values); health.changed adds destinations, the ones whose health flipped.

response.description: The first 512 bytes of the answer.

devices.description: desktop, mobile, tablet, bot or other.

referrers.description: Referrer host, or (direct) when there was none.

rows_scanned.description: Rollup rows and sketches read, counted against the cost limit.

include_bots.description: Whether clicks of device class bot are counted.

bot_list_version.description: Version of the list of automated User-Agents that classifies clicks as bots.

series.description: Every point of the period, with 0 where there were no clicks.

groups.description: The top groups by clicks, most first; ties in byte order of the values.

key.description: Value per grouped dimension; a link as code or hostname/code.

series.description: Points with clicks only; absent for granularity all.

click_id.description: The rl_cid the click brought to the destination.

event.description: What happened, such as signup or purchase.

value.description: In minor units of currency (cents), or a plain number without one.

external_id.description: Your id for the conversion, such as an order number: counted once per event whichever click it names.

occurred_at.description: Default: now. At most 5 minutes ahead of the server's clock, and from 5 minutes before the click to its attribution window after.

domain.description: The link's custom domain; null for the default domain.

target.description: What chose the URL the click went to.

variant.description: The destination's index (the A/B variant) when target is destination.

rule.description: The targeting rule's index when target is rule.

destination.description: The URL the click went to; null once neither the link nor its kept versions have it.

duplicate.description: true when this conversion had been posted before.

converted_clicks.description: Distinct clicks with at least one conversion.

values.description: Value totals per currency, null first for plain numbers.

current.description: One of the link's destinations as they are now.

LinkSettings.description: A link's settings as one version holds them, destinations and rule and store URLs normalised.

member.description: Who made the change; null for the server or an operator.

source.description: migration marks the first version of a link created before version history existed.

restored_from.description: For a rollback, the version whose settings it restored.

schedule_id.description: For a scheduled change, its schedule.

CreateSchedule.description: Give url or destinations, enabled, or both.

change.description: The fields the schedule changes, destinations normalised.

finished_at.description: When it was applied, failed or was cancelled.

applied_version.description: The link version the change produced, or the one already current when it changed nothing.

error.description: Why it could not be applied.

domain.description: Only the links on this custom domain of the workspace.

filter.description: codes (1 to 1000), on domain or else the default domain; or all: true, every link, or every link on domain.

row.description: The record's number: 1 is the first after a CSV header; for a patch, the code's place in filter.codes.

code.description: The error code the same API request would get.

output_url.description: Where a succeeded export's file is.

errors.description: On GET /v1/jobs/{id} only: the first 100 rows that failed.
